offerDisclaimer.title: Offer Terms & Conditions Confirmation
offerDisclaimer.body:
By creating this offer, the seller declares and agrees to:

• Fulfill the agreed payments to the Lead Manager according to the established terms.
• Respect the payment deadlines defined in the offer and make payments in a timely manner.
• Manage received leads appropriately, professionally, and in accordance with best business practices.
• That the platform is not responsible for payment breaches, delays, or disputes that arise between seller and lead manager.
• That all information provided in this offer is truthful, accurate, and complete.

Failure to comply with these conditions may result in suspension or cancellation of the seller's account.

question1.a: A Lead Manager is a person or entity that has a network of contacts and connects them with companies looking for potential customers, earning compensation for successful conversions.

question2.q: What can I offer as a lead?
question2.a: You can offer any contact that might be interested in products or services from sellers on the platform. This includes business contacts, professional connections, or individuals matching specific criteria.

question3.a: You receive payment when a lead you provide is marked as WON (successfully converted). Payments can be fixed amounts or percentage-based commissions, depending on each offer's terms.

question4.q: What legal requirements do I need to meet?
question4.a: You must declare ownership of contact data using your RUT or Passport. You're responsible for ensuring all data has been obtained lawfully and with proper consent according to data protection regulations.

question5.q: What contact data is visible to sellers?
question5.a: Contact details remain anonymized until your proposal is accepted. Once accepted, the seller receives the full contact information to pursue the lead.
